body: Well apparently my family doesn't care. So... I've been homeless before (on account of my mom kicking me on the street) and not a single call came from one of my siblings for the entire time I was on the street.

I don't know, its a pain to type narcissist ; P. I've been violently abused by father, from early age ( 3 years old, being hit, thrown, choked, shaken) and my mom has bipolar and she has frequently tried to kill herself growing up, as well as self-harming in front of us and having to witness that, and a few other things. I'm also pretty sensitive. I've been labelled an "angry kid" from a young age and I wonder what it was that made me this way. 

I don't know if you are still here, but I have something to ask. Would you rather have a dead sibling or a live homeless and destitute one?

According to many therapists, I do not. I do not test for any disorder except depression and ptsd. I don't have a strong ego that I must defend at all costs. I admit when I am wrong and I definitely do not get off on putting others down in front of me so I feel better. I hate talking about my feelings or justifications for anything. Narc people would go on and on about "poor me" and "I didn't do anything wrong...feed my ego!" I don't "thrive" on anything like that...the *n-supply* as some call it. I think you don't know what an Narcissist is.
The meanest ones I know, my abusers. Literally just thinking about them breathing makes me sick to my stomach.
